text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Nakayama Festa was challenging herself
to build a giant house of cards...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, the summit's coming into view...
Alright――... Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...No, let's take a break for a second.
If I tense up too much, my hands will start shaking.
Time to catch my breath and—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? You gotta be kidding, falling over from that...!
...Dammit, now everything's ruined!
